body:
Refs #19 (FA-018). Closure is a separate step; the GitHub issue stays OPEN.

## Problem
The upstream completion helper stored any event carrying a verdict string and a caller timestamp and selected approved records by time alone: `schema_version=null`, unrelated events, caller `completeness=false`, NaN timestamps and the string `"false"` all became approvals. A verdict's existence proved nothing about which execution, spec, artifact or reviewer it judged.

## Change (bounded)
- `domain/completion.py` (stdlib only): closed schema `parse_verdict` — exact key set, `schema_version == 1`, event name, verdict ∈ {approved, iterate, escalate}, typed target (task/generation/attempt), 40-hex spec revision, `sha256:` evaluation artifact, runner receipt whose target must equal the verdict's (cross-target derived from the receipt, never a caller flag), reviewer (actor, kind), explicit scenario denominator (expected/passed/human-approved exclusions with revision and reason), aware ISO `observed_at` (numbers, NaN, naive and future rejected), 64 KiB cap. Identity excludes `observed_at`.
- `application/completion.py`: `CompletionAuthority.record()` keeps malformed input as structured rejection notices (same malformed replay → same notice), binds valid verdicts to the current `tasks` row generation/attempt in the same transaction, sequences per task; redelivery returns the original row and sequence. `inspect()` names every ledger state — `unreadable`, `no_ledger`, `corrupt`, `partially_corrupt`, `rejected_only`, `not_evaluated`, `stale`, `not_approved`, `incomplete`, `not_succeeded`, `authoritative` — and only the last grants authority; `require_authority()` refuses everything else. The latest verdict is the last recorded one, never the latest timestamp.
- Task `succeeded` remains the executor's self-report; dispatch does not consult this ledger yet (issue rollback: inactive until qualified).
- `docs/contracts.md`: INV-COMPLETION-001. Record: `docs/zeus/implementation/completion-authority-001/` (README + target-test receipt with negative controls).

## Verification
- `tests/test_completion_authority.py` (17 tests, MemoryStore + isolated PostgreSQL schema): 21 malformed shapes + cross-target receipt refused and logged without inflation; worker success ≠ authority; binding to execution/spec/artifact; reclaimed execution makes old verdicts stale and late gen-1 verdicts are refused; recording order beats observed time, replay keeps its sequence, same-second verdicts resolve by sequence; empty denominator is incomplete, human-approved exclusion completes; 8 concurrent identical records → one row; real-PG row corruption (`UPDATE documents`) → `corrupt`/`partially_corrupt`; unreachable DSN → `unreadable`; all 11 states reached.
- Negative controls: modules removed → collection error; `latest()` by `observed_at` → 2 ordering tests fail; binding check removed → 4 tests fail.
- Windows full suite on origin/main `1488468`: 959 passed, 318 skipped. `ruff check` clean.

## Not claimed
Runner receipt, evaluation artifact and reviewer values in tests are fixtures; no real evaluator provider, hook host, human scenario acceptance or Linux/WSL run. Existence/immutability of the referenced spec revision and artifact is not verified by this ledger (format only).

comments.body:
검토 반영 — `ac43634` (P1: 존재하지 않는 실행·평가 증적도 completion authority)

**변경** (`application/completion.py`): `CompletionAuthority(store, artifacts=None, org=None)`. `authoritative` 앞에 `_provenance`가 문서 밖 출처를 검사합니다 —
- `receipt_unbound`: `runner_receipt.id`가 task row가 기록한 `result.execution_ref`와 같고 `digest`가 그 ref의 해시가 아니면.
- `artifact_missing`: artifact store가 없거나 execution ref·evaluation_artifact가 실재(`artifacts.inspect`)하지 않으면.
- `reviewer_unbound`: reviewer가 조직 actor가 아니거나 실행 agent 자신이면.
- `scenario_mismatch`: 소비자가 넘긴 승인 spec의 `expected_scenarios`와 분모가 다르면.
`require_authority`도 `expected_scenarios`를 받습니다. 네 상태 모두 `STATES`에 추가.

**테스트** (`tests/test_completion_authority.py`): 실제 FileArtifacts에 execution/evaluation 문서를 두고 worker 완료가 `execution_ref`를 기록하는 흐름으로 전부 재작성; 새 검사에서 조작된 execution_ref → `receipt_unbound`, 빈 artifact store → `artifact_missing`(ref 명시), worker 자신·미지 actor → `reviewer_unbound`, 분모 불일치 → `scenario_mismatch`, 일치 시에만 `authoritative`; 도달 가능 상태 집합 갱신.

main(`66076cc`) 위로 rebase. 로컬(MemoryStore + 격리 PG): 19 passed; Ruff 통과.

reviews.body:
# PR #50: 변경 요청 / 병합 보류

검토 head: `7866032f8d485995f2ead86dc59449f273e37397`. Codex 독립 검토입니다.

**[P1] 존재하지 않는 실행·평가 증적도 completion authority가 됩니다**

worker task를 succeeded로 만든 뒤 실제 receipt/artifact를 하나도 생성하지 않고 형식만 맞춘 runner_receipt digest와 evaluation_artifact를 record하면 inspect가 state=authoritative, authority=true를 반환합니다. 같은 JSON 안의 값 비교는 출처 검증이 아닙니다.

위치: [src/codex_harness/application/completion.py:36](https://github.com/trevi00/zeus/blob/7866032f8d485995f2ead86dc59449f273e37397/src/codex_harness/application/completion.py#L36)

수정·재검증 조건: 독립 runner 원장/불변 artifact 실재와 digest, reviewer 출처 및 승인된 spec의 scenario 분모를 검증하세요. 연결 전에는 claim/advisory로 유지하고 require_authority가 허용하지 않아야 합니다.

검증: 해당 head의 대상 검사 **21 passed in 16.62s**, Ruff 통과. 개별 대상 검사에 PostgreSQL 통합을 활성화했습니다. 통과 횟수는 파일 간 중복을 포함하므로 고유 테스트 수로 합산하지 않습니다.

실제 모델·사람 인수·실기기·재부팅 검증은 수행하지 않았습니다. PR 수용과 연결 이슈의 완료/종료는 별도입니다.
